rival.name: {rival}
dialog: {rival}: Oreburgh City's just through the gate! Get a move on!

lass.name: Lass
dialog: Whichever Pokémon is first in your party is the one that goes out first.
So put the one you trust most at the top!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Michael: My Pokémon are what get me out of bed in the morning! Go, both of you!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Michael: Through the grass, or past the trainers? I can never make up my mind which is worse.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Dallas: Me and my Shinx go everywhere together. Nothing comes between us!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Dallas: I'm not sore about it. We'll just have to get tougher, the two of us.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Sebastian: I'm on my way to challenge the Gym. You'll do for a warm-up!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Sebastian: So I'm not ready for the Gym yet. Good thing I found out here.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Madeline: Look what the Gym Leader in Oreburgh City gave me! Want to see how I won it?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Madeline: I'm going to collect every Badge there is. They're so shiny!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Lass Kaitlin: I was looking for Pokémon, and I found a trainer instead!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Lass Kaitlin: I just keep walking through the grass until the one I want jumps out.

Route 203
East: Oreburgh Gate, Oreburgh City
signs.trainer_tips_signpost_east:
Trainer Tips
A Pokémon that is about to evolve can be stopped. Press Cancel while it changes and it stays as it is.
signs.trainer_tips_signpost_west:
Trainer Tips
Every move can only be used so many times: its PP. A Pokémon Center restores the PP of every move.
